comment: Kaizo battle start conditions the ROM extractor cannot derive unambiguously (tools/rom/readers/maps.py trainer_start_conditions, plan K2b Ruling 8).

Keys are numeric trainer ids (the id in trainers.json); each value is {"trainer": the Kaizo ROM text name at that id (TEXT_BANK_NPC_TRAINER_NAMES), "condition": none | rain | hail | sandstorm | sun | fog | unknown}. The extractor checks the name against the ROM, so an id drift fails loudly.

Only trainers whose maps give more than one condition belong here; an entry may not contradict an unambiguous derivation. 'unknown' is written to trainers.json as is: the evidence does not settle the condition, and extract_rom prints every such trainer.

Evidence per entry: the ROM maps (d_test.narc header ids; map weather decoded by maps.weather_switch_conditions), the Kaizo docs sheet (sheet:row of the trainer header and its section header) and PKCalc pkcalc/src/js/data/flags.js (zip SHA-256 849733e6...): FLAGS_PK weather lists sun 518-570, rain 571-671, sand 672-707, hail 708-777, fog 778-836; a label in none of them has no PKCalc weather.

ROM: header 89 (fog) battles 318 by script (script 96 offsets 363 and 543) and is reached directly from the entrance header 88 (warp); 318 is also placed on headers 95 (weather 28: none) and 100 (none). 325 Morton, 343 Fantina? (Hearthome Gym; fix round 1). A trainer id is fought once (its trainer flag), in the room where the player meets it first, so the condition is the first room's only if the room order is fixed. ROM: 325 is an object event in header 89 (fog) and header 93 (weather 26: none); 343 is a script battle of header 91 (script 98 offset 365, none) and an object event in headers 94 (fog) and 97 (none). The warps (zone_event.narc warp events) show the entrance header 88 warping straight to 89, 90 and 91, so 89 is not shown to come before 93; 91 does come before 94 and 97 (92 is entered only from 91 or 95, 93 only from 92, 94 and 97 only from 93), but whether the header 91 battle with 343 must be fought there was not established. Sheet: Fantina Split:271 'Policeman Morton (FOG, Also Appears in Room 5)' (section :258 Room #1); :339 'Leader Fantina ? (Also Appears in Room 6, Separate Fight)' (section :336 Room #3, no tag). PKCalc: 'Policeman Morton' fog flags.js:781; 'Leader Fantina?' in no weather list. The room order is not established, so both stay unknown.
